svg.title: A continuum of Recursive Emergence
svg.desc: Nine concentric rings, one per layer from cosmos to the synthetic layer, each labelled with thinkers. Every ring has a gap, the residue it cannot close from inside; a thread of recursion starts at a central dot and passes out through each gap, past a dashed edge into an open haze marked: whatever comes next.

textPath.tspan: what no layer can settle from inside
